name: Five in Frills
source:
'Five in Frills' is a story of a young girl named Minami Ishikawa working as a maid in an old mansion. Locals say that mansion is a rotten place and usually try to avoid it. Do they have reasons or that's just some sort of a local legend? Time will show.
But first she has to meet the other four maids working there already.

[From [url=https://dark-sentinel.itch.io/five-in-frills]itch.io[/url]]

Created for NaNoRenO 2016.
translation:
《Five in Frills》讲述了一个名叫石川美波的年轻女孩在一座古老宅邸里担任女仆的故事。当地人说那座宅邸是个腐朽之地，通常都会避而远之。他们是有什么理由，还是那只是一种地方传说？时间会给出答案。

但首先，她得先见见已经在那里工作的另外四名女仆。

[来源：[url=https://dark-sentinel.itch.io/five-in-frills]itch.io[/url]]

为NaNoRenO 2016制作。
